Explorations

Adventures & Travels

Exploring and Learning

Mustang, Nepal

Thorang La Pass

Standing at 5,416m, crossing Thorang La Pass is one of the most exhilarating moments on the Annapurna Circuit — cold wind, thin air, and an endless sea of Himalayan peaks stretching in every direction.

Manang, Nepal

Tilicho Lake

At 4,919m, Tilicho is one of the highest lakes in the world. The turquoise waters ringed by snow-capped ridges feel completely otherworldly — a place that humbles you into silence.

Manang, Nepal

Gunsang to Yak Kharka

The trail from Gunsang up to Yak Kharka winds through high alpine terrain, where yak herders roam and the air grows thin — a raw, beautiful stretch of the Annapurna Circuit.

Mustang, Nepal

Way to Thorang La

The trail to Thorang La winds through high-altitude desert landscapes — stark, windswept, and hauntingly beautiful. Every step feels earned at this altitude.

Mustang, Nepal

Annapurna Circuit Range

Trekking above 4,000m, the world strips down to essentials — rock, sky, and the crunch of boots on frozen ground. The silence here is something you carry home with you.

Kaski, Nepal

Annapurna Base Camp

Standing at 4,130m inside the Annapurna Sanctuary, glaciers hang off sheer walls on all sides. The thin air and towering eight-thousanders make this a moment that truly changes you.
